hypothesis: The retained v39 event stream cannot identify per-key physical held-input duration: it records 39 input admissions and 28 held-key snapshots, but only program-level verified-empty release endpoints, with no per-key release timestamp.
treatment: Parse the immutable v39 runtime event stream; count per-key admission/snapshot/release records; validate the distinction with positive and negative synthetic controls.
decision_rule: PASS_IDENTIFIABILITY_LIMIT only if the frozen raw event counts match, all 9 terminal release records verify empty input, the single input_released event verifies empty input, no per-key release timestamp exists, the positive control is recognized, and the negative control is not misclassified.
scope: No new model, game, GUI, input, Docker, GPU, provider, or network experiment. This is a posthoc telemetry-identifiability result, not an estimate of physical key occupancy or a live-control result.
